title: Bluewater Plumbing — feature dump, unhandled price objection
description: Rep (Maya, Relay) pitches Tom, owner of a 9-tech plumbing company, almost immediately. Tom raises a price objection that the rep talks past, mentions a competitor (DispatchPro) that is never addressed, gets confused by jargon, and gradually disengages. Ends with 'just send me some info'.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Hi Tom, Maya from Relay. Thanks for taking the call.

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: Hey. Yeah, I've got maybe twenty minutes, I'm between jobs.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: No problem, I'll be quick. So Relay is a field service scheduling and dispatch platform. We help plumbing, HVAC, and electrical companies automate their daily board, route techs efficiently, re-dispatch in real time when jobs run long, and keep customers updated automatically with SMS. We integrate with all the major accounting packages, we've got a mobile app for technicians with GPS tracking, digital job forms, photo capture, and customer signatures, and our routing engine saves customers an average of eleven percent in drive time.

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: And on top of that, the dispatcher dashboard gives you a live map view of every tech, color-coded by job status, with drag and drop rescheduling. You can set up automated reminders, review requests after each job, and there's a reporting suite with first-time fix rate, revenue per tech, and utilization. A lot of our customers say the reporting alone paid for the product.

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: Right. How many techs do your customers usually have? We're nine guys.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Nine is a great fit. We have customers from five techs up to several hundred. The platform scales with you, so as you grow you never have to switch systems. And the onboarding is really smooth, we have a dedicated implementation team, video training, and a knowledge base.

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: What does it cost?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: For nine techs you'd be on our Growth plan, which is eight hundred and fifty a month on annual billing, and that includes the mobile app, customer texting, and the reporting suite.

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: Eight fifty a month? That's over ten grand a year. We're a nine-man shop, Maya. That's a lot of money for a calendar.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: I hear you, but it's much more than a calendar. The routing optimization alone typically saves eleven percent in drive time, and the digital forms eliminate paperwork. Plus the review automation drives more Google reviews, which brings in new customers. Most customers see ROI within the first quarter.

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: Sure, everyone says that. My guys know their routes, they've been driving this town for fifteen years.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: That's great local knowledge. What Relay adds on top is the real-time piece: when a job runs long, the system automatically re-sequences the rest of the day and notifies the customers. We also have a parts and inventory module, so techs can see what's on their truck, and a customer portal where clients can book online.

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: We looked at DispatchPro last year, they were about half that price.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Yeah, there are a lot of options out there. What sets Relay apart is really the depth of the platform. Let me tell you about our integrations: we sync two-way with your accounting, so invoices flow automatically, and payments can be taken in the field through the app. That closes the loop from dispatch to cash collection.

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: What do you mean, closes the loop?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: So the whole lifecycle, from the job being created, through dispatch, execution, invoicing, and payment, all lives in one system of record with full audit trails, and the data model supports multi-entity setups if you ever open a second location.

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: Uh huh.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: And I should mention our customer success program. Every account gets quarterly business reviews where we go through your utilization and first-time fix metrics and recommend optimizations. Our customers really value that partnership approach.

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: Look, I don't really have time for quarterly reviews. I'm on the tools half the week myself.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Totally understand, they're optional. The nice thing is the reporting is all self-serve too, so you can check the dashboards whenever you want from your phone. And the setup is really quick, most customers are live within two weeks.

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: Two weeks of what, though? Who's doing the setup? I don't have an office person.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Our implementation team handles most of it. They'll import your customer list, set up your service types and pricing, configure the mobile app, and train the team. There are a few onboarding calls but it's pretty light. Then you're up and running with the full platform.

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: Hm. And it's eight fifty regardless? No smaller plan?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Growth is our entry plan for teams over five techs. It really does include everything: dispatch, routing, app, texting, reporting, inventory, portal. The value is in the whole package. And honestly the annual commitment is what lets us offer that price.

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: Annual. Right.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Yes, twelve months, billed upfront or monthly. Most customers go upfront for the discount. And we have a ninety-day satisfaction window on the enterprise tier, though that tier starts at twenty-five techs.

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: So no way out on my plan.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: The annual plan is a commitment, yes, but our retention is over ninety-five percent, so customers are very happy. I'd love to show you the dispatcher dashboard live, it really comes to life when you see the map view with the techs moving around and the drag and drop rescheduling.

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: Maybe. I'd have to think about it.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Of course. I can also send over some case studies, we have a great one from a plumbing company in Ohio with twelve techs that grew to twenty after switching to Relay, and their first-time fix rate went up fourteen points.

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: Yeah, just send me some info and I'll take a look when I get a chance.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Absolutely. Would it make sense to put thirty minutes on the calendar next week for a demo, maybe Tuesday or Wednesday?

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: Let me look at the info first. I'm slammed next week anyway.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Understood. I'll send the case studies, the pricing sheet, and a recorded demo video so you can watch it whenever. And I'll follow up in a couple of weeks.

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: Sure. Okay, I've got to run, my next job is waiting.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: No problem, thanks Tom, talk soon.

utterances.speaker: prospect
utterances.text: Bye.
